logistics.format: Web-based proctored, open-book reference (ProctorU or PearsonVUE)

recommended_certs.rationale: CySA+ で SOC 1次/2次対応の基礎を整えてから、SANS SEC450 系の GSOC に進むと現場プロセスとログ分析の理解が深まる。

minus.note: 求人要件としては CySA+ や Blue Team Level 1 のほうが頻出。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded one-year profile and explicit SOC entry-role fit support associate analyst knowledge; accreditation does not overcome its baseline scope or weaker hiring visibility for a higher tier.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accreditation and direct blue-team entry-role coverage support associate SOC hiring with a one-year profile. Its open-book exam and limited comparative hiring recognition do not establish professional response responsibility.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded entry SOC role fit and one-year profile support associate security-operations knowledge. Accreditation and training pedigree do not establish professional incident ownership from the open-book examination alone.
